title: polypodium camptocarpum
intro: Polypodium camptocarpum, commonly known as the "wild fern", is a type of fern that belongs to the Polypodiaceae family. It is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used in various cultures for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium camptocarpum include its ability to reduce fever, soothe digestive issues, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
